cases.description: One package source feeds an original-file sink and a transformed-file sink with independently checked bytes and completion.

cases.description: A conditional ESM package re-export tees an iterable; cancelling an unused branch must not truncate the other or hang its cleanup.

cases.description: Three downstream cancellations reach the original once in branch order, and a falsy asynchronous cleanup failure reaches all cancelling consumers.

cases.description: One sink fails halfway through a duplicated source; the surviving sink still writes the whole input and the failed pipe retains its exact reason.
